description: Aree di circolazione pedonale sul territorio del Comune di Siena is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.comune.siena.it. Dataset containing the area intended for pedestrian circulation, it includes all sections of the road platform that within urban areas are reserved for pedestrian transit, i.e. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian circulation areas on the territory of the Municipality of Siena" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include territorio, trasporti. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
